none: PAS CAM-978992: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of Licinius
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ CAESARVM NOSTRORVM ; D/ LICINIVS IVN NOB [...]

Copper alloy Nummus of Licinius. Mint is Siscia, AD320-321, (Reece period 16). Reverse legend reads CAESARVM NOSTRORVM. Reverse shows VOT/V in two lines in laurel wreath. RIC VII p.444,no.162. Obverse shows Laureate bust right. Obverse legend reads LICINIVS IVN NOB [...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: -/-//ASIS*. Condition Fine.,die axis is 6 o,clock. Weight 3.22g, diameter 19.87mm
